title: Jupiter is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign

text.en: Jupiter is dignified, traditionally a sign of wisdom, respect and contentment in later years.
text.impact: Later years tend to bring respect, and the comfort of having enough.

title: The 4th lord is dignified or in a kendra or trikona

text.en: The lord of the 4th house, home and comforts, is dignified or well placed: traditionally a sign of a settled home in later life.
text.impact: A settled home in later life: your own place, and the comforts you have built up over the years.

title: The 11th lord is dignified or in a kendra or trikona

text.en: The lord of the 11th house, gains, is dignified or well placed: traditionally a sign of continuing income.
text.impact: Income tends to continue past the working years, through a pension, rent, returns, or work you still enjoy doing.

title: Saturn is exalted, in moolatrikona or in its own sign

text.en: Saturn, which classically governs old age, is dignified: traditionally a sign of steady, disciplined later years.
text.impact: Old age is Saturn's own ground. A disciplined, self-reliant later life with good endurance is the usual reading.

text.en: Saturn, which classically governs old age, is debilitated, unless the debilitation is cancelled: planning and routine help in later years.
text.impact: Later years benefit from planning ahead: savings, routine, and people around you. What is arranged early makes the difference.

title: A benefic occupies the 12th, or Jupiter aspects it

text.en: A benefic occupies or Jupiter aspects the 12th house, the house of rest and spiritual life: traditionally a peaceful retirement.
text.impact: A peaceful retirement is indicated: rest, and time for inner life or pilgrimage if that appeals to you.

title: The Sun, Mars, Saturn or Rahu occupies the 12th house

text.en: A natural malefic occupies the 12th house, traditionally a sign of expenses to plan for. (Ketu in the 12th is classically favourable for spiritual life and is not counted.)
text.impact: Later years tend to carry higher outgoings, through family, travel or medical costs. Planning for them well ahead is the practical answer.
